Name: Wyman Manderly
CharacterDescription: Wyman Manderly is the Lord of White Harbor and the head of House Manderly. He also holds several honorary titles: Warden of the White Knife, Shield of the Faith, Defender of the Dispossessed, Lord Marshal of the Mander, and Knight of the Order of the Green Hand. A widower for the past eight years, Wyman has two adult sons, Ser Wylis and Ser Wendel Manderly. Wyman is amiable and has a loud, booming laugh. By his own admission, and because of his physical appearance, Wyman is seen by many as craven and foolish. This is a clever front, however, as Wyman is shrewd, calculating, and intelligent. Lord Manderly is also staunchly loyal to House Stark.
